claims.claim: Stem Q2 revenue was $33.7M, down 12% Y/Y, while software/services/edge-hardware revenue was $33.4M, up 1%, and PowerTrack software revenue rose 11% Y/Y.
Bookings rose 39% sequentially to $36.8M, backlog rose 18% to $27.1M and management reaffirmed 2026 guidance.

risks.risk: Total revenue still contracted year over year and cash remains limited relative to larger peers.

contradictions.contradiction: Improving margins, bookings and recurring software metrics coexist with declining total revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Backlog conversion timing and recurring-margin contribution remain unknown.

claims.claim: GAAP gross margin improved to 41% from 33%; adjusted EBITDA reached $6.2M and operating cash flow was positive $0.3M versus negative $21.3M a year earlier.

risks.risk: Net loss remains negative despite adjusted EBITDA progress.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of positive operating cash flow across multiple quarters remains unknown.
Independent market-expectations benchmark for reaffirmed guidance is absent from cumulative Scout evidence.
